description: Publicly reported waterlogging hotspots in Delhi, compiled from official announcements (PWD, Delhi Traffic Police) as quoted in news reports, plus locations reported waterlogged in specific storms. This is NOT the full official list (PWD identified 445 points for 2025, but the point-by-point list is not published). Coordinates are geocoded from the names with OpenStreetMap Nominatim and reviewed by hand; they are approximate (about +-150 m).
